faq.answer_text: The certification exam consists of exactly 30 items covering crucial installation, initial configuration, and system upgrade tasks designed to test your administrative expertise and technical skills.

faq.answer_text: Passing score requirements and specific threshold metrics are determined directly by F5 Networks; check with F5 Networks for the current certification path details and passing standards.
The exam has a strict total duration of 30 minutes to complete all items and successfully answer every single question presented on the test without exception.
The standard exam price is $50 USD. It represents an important milestone as one of five exams required for the F5 Certified Administrator credential program.

editorial.overview: The BIG-IP Administration Install, Initial Configuration, and Upgrade certification exam is officially provided by F5 Networks. It thoroughly evaluates candidate knowledge and technical capabilities in installing, securely configuring, and upgrading BIG-IP systems, including management connectivity procedures and software licensing operations across supported hardware platforms for network professionals seeking credentials.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review official F5 Networks documentation regarding initial setup procedures, automated and manual license activation methods, and rSeries configuration tasks. Practice configuring management IP addresses, DNS settings, NTP synchronization, and security parameters across your BIG-IP lab environment to ensure complete readiness before test day arrives for the certification program.
editorial.who_should_take: Administrators and network professionals responsible for deploying, configuring, and upgrading F5 BIG-IP systems. Candidates should have practical experience with initial device setup, license activation, and security hardening.
